dct_creator_sm: Canada Health Infoway (OTHER, Canada Health Infoway, Leger).
dct_description_sm: This dataset is the latest quantitative survey of Canadian nurses' access to and use of digital health in practice. It was a joint collaboration between the Canadian Nurses Association, Canadian Nursing Informatics Association and Canada Health Infoway.
dct_rights_sm: This dataset is made available with limited information on how it can be used. You may wish to communicate with the Contact(s) specified before use.
dct_title_s: 2017 National Survey of Canadian Nurses: Use of Digital Health Technology in Practice
